_doc: P300 multi-target calibration campaign — RESEARCH-ONLY, ADVISORY. Per target: recall (read-only from match_matrix) + novelty (KB chroma) + executed-PoC validity (P294 verifier; exploit + logic_differential). Answer keys + contest source READ-ONLY. ground_truth + promote_learning NOT touched (human-only); FP rejection-rule proposals staged to data/learning/_proposed/ only.

validity_targets.mechanism: incorrect reward distribution: _accrueFee mints fee shares to feeRecipient via _update which triggers _claimRewards/_afterTokenTransfer BEFORE the user's action, so reward accrual is mis-attributed (feeShares minted at the wrong point shift reward distribution)

deflation/rounding: deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem accrue fee shares via _accruedFeeShares (Floor rounding on totalSupply + newTotalAssets-feeAssets) enabling a first/market-deposit rounding (deflation) attack on share price

transform() approves the position NFT to a whitelisted transformer and executes transformer.call(data) BEFORE the end-of-call health check; the unvalidated tokenId encoded in `data` lets a caller act on a position/token other than the intended one (the awarded root cause is the unvalidated data input, not just transformer trust)

rounding-direction mismatch: in the cross-shortfall branch the converted bonus uses convert0to1/convert1to0 (rounding toward zero) while the offsetting deduction uses the opposite conversion, so the two legs round inconsistently and the bonus/shortfall accounting is off (ADJACENT — right area; build to the rounding-direction differential, refute honestly if it doesn't hold)
